item.title: US intelligence chief says Trump’s ‘friend’ label for Putin is ‘entirely appropriate’
item.description: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said on Sunday it was “entirely appropriate” for US President Donald Trump to call Russian leader Vladimir Putin his friend. Clayton defended comments that Democrats have characterised as a betrayal of American values after Trump met Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping for rare three-way talks. item.title: 3 killed and 1 wounded in shooting at Ohio baby shower, police say
item.description: Three people were killed and one was injured at an Ohio baby shower during an apparent domestic dispute, authorities said. Officers responded to a shooting on Saturday evening at Pandora’s Magical Events Venue in Parma, about 16km (10 miles) south of Cleveland, a police news release said. Authorities said one of the suspected shooters, a 29-year-old man, was taken into custody but he was not immediately charged. item.title: Russian strikes kill 6 in Kyiv region, Ukraine says
item.description: Russian strikes across the Kyiv region, including on a block of flats that partially collapsed, killed at least six people, Ukraine said on Sunday, warning there could be more victims under the rubble. Russia has been pummelling Ukraine with nightly aerial barrages as the war-torn country braces for another winter of the near-five-year invasion.
